visual.general_description: Pair of growth charts, height and weight versus months, of the case against five standard reference curves.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side growth charts in one image: a Height chart on the left (y-axis cm, x-axis Mo) and a Weight chart on the right (y-axis kg, x-axis Mo), each showing five reference curves labeled +2SD, +1SD, Average, −1SD, −2SD and two overlaid case series with printed value labels. The panels carry no printed panel letters; the letters A and B come from the legend text.

panels.general_description: Height growth chart of the case plotted against five standard reference curves, 0 to 26 Mo.
panels.detailed_description: Line chart titled Height with y-axis labeled cm from 40 to 100 and x-axis labeled Mo from 0 to 26. Five smooth reference curves run left to right, labeled at the right edge +2SD, +1SD, Average, −1SD and −2SD, drawn in red, pink, blue, pink and red. Two overlaid case series, a black line with round markers and a green line with diamond markers, start near 45 cm at 0 Mo, lie below the −2SD curve from about 1 to 9 Mo, then run close to the −2SD curve and end near 78 cm at about 23 Mo. Printed value labels include 51, 51.5, 53.7, 53.8, 56.4, 60.1, 62.5, 65.8, 66, 67.2, 67.7, 71.9, 74.1, 76 (several times) and 78.7; the labels at the start overlap and are not fully legible.
